title: Gemini thinking settings speak the right dialect
summary:
Gemini thinking requests and GPT Image edits got practical fixes, while publishable-key guidance and a community app link got tidied up.

Gemini 2.5, 3 Flash, and 3 Pro thinking settings now use Portkey-compatible request formats. Requests can specify `thinking_budget` directly or use a `thinking` object; a zero budget maps to the setting each model supports, including low reasoning for Gemini 3 Pro, which cannot fully disable thinking.

GPT Image editing now scales down oversized inputs without changing their aspect ratio and selects output sizes by the closest supported aspect ratio. Image-generation requests are no longer charged when a successful HTTP response contains text or JSON instead of image or video content.

Docs now label publishable keys as Alpha, clarify their 1 Pollen per hour per IP+key limit, and use a simpler `?key=YOUR_KEY` example. The Word Master app listing now points to wordwagon.cloud rather than an ngrok tunnel.
